title: Own the M2 PR Profile authority implementation paths
goal: Provide unique exact path ownership for M2 contracts Host behavior and tests in the PR root plan-set.
acceptanceCriteria: Inert discovery is deterministic bounded and cannot execute or mutate Target code.
Drafts remain snapshot-bound StateRoot data and empty coverage remains visibly unprotected.
Review validation fails closed on stale identity schema capability configuration fixture coverage or policy drift.
Promotion emits only a portable candidate compatible with the existing sibling composer and records all unperformed authority boundaries.
Focused and affected regression suites pass without changing the frozen stable CLI compatibility baseline.
risks: Discovery could cross a link or inspect content outside its allowlist.
A stale or self-authored review could convert recommendations into apparent policy.
Candidate output could be mistaken for an installed or selected composition.
decisions: Keep the M2 command surface experimental and separate from the frozen stable CLI contract.
Require exact snapshot draft review Module configuration capability and fixture bindings.
Emit a promotion candidate without Target apply composition selection or CI activation.
